attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Indiana military retirement income exclusion. Skeleton: per IC 6-3-2-3.7 (2025), 100% exclusion of military retirement pay + SBP, extended to Space Force / USPHS / NOAA Corps in 2025. Honors MSRRA / SCRA. Not currently wired in — see issue #446.

Indiana state income tax. Flat 3.00% rate (IC 6-3-2-1, 2025) on AGI minus total exemptions. Exemptions: $1,000 per taxpayer + $1,500 per dependent. Writes result.in_taxable_income and result.in_state_tax.

initial_action.action_comment: Reset IN tax fields and log calculation start
initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.in_state_tax = 0; set result.in_taxable_income = 0; set result.in_total_exemptions = 0; add " Indiana Tax Calculation (Form IT-40) - flat 3.00%" to job.audit_trail
initial_action.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.in_state_tax xdef 0.0 /result.in_taxable_income xdef 0.0 /result.in_total_exemptions xdef " Indiana Tax Calculation (Form IT-40) — flat 3.00%" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Compute IN exemptions, taxable income, and flat tax
action_details.action_dsl: set result.in_total_exemptions = length of job.taxpayers * in_personal_exemption + length of job.dependents * in_dependent_exemption; set result.in_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - result.in_total_exemptions) and 0.0; set result.in_state_tax = result.in_taxable_income * in_tax_rate; add " IN exemptions: $" + result.in_total_exemptions to job.audit_trail; add " IN state tax (3.00%): $" + result.in_state_tax to job.audit_trail
action_details.action_postfix: job.taxpayers length cvd in_personal_exemption f* job.dependents length cvd in_dependent_exemption f* f+ /result.in_total_exemptions xdef result.agi result.in_total_exemptions f- 0.0 fmax /result.in_taxable_income xdef result.in_taxable_income in_tax_rate f* /result.in_state_tax xdef " IN exemptions ($1,000/taxpayer + $1,500/dependent): $" result.in_total_exemptions cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " IN taxable income: $" result.in_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " IN state tax (flat 3.00%): $" result.in_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

policy_statement.policy_description: IN flat tax: 3.00% × max(AGI − exemptions, 0); exemptions = $1,000/taxpayer + $1,500/dependent
